FULL.description: The complete downloadable card: contact rows, the full verification chain, and the photo when one is published.

COMPACT.description: The density-limited card meant for optical scanning: contact rows plus the minimum verification chain, and nothing whose absence is recoverable from the profile the signature binds.

SIGNING_KEY.description: The literal public key that produced the profile's signature.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: The literal public key a correspondent encrypts to.

PROFILE_SIGNATURE.description: The profile's own signature value, so a scanner can verify without a second fetch.

PROFILE_SIGNATURE_TIMESTAMP.description: The profile's signature timestamp, as the publisher stated it.

PROFILE_CONTENT_ID.description: Content identifier of the exact profile bytes the card projects.

LEDGER_ACCOUNT.description: A distributed-ledger account the profile proves control of. CHAIN names which ledger.

OTHER.description: A row whose kind this standard does not model. KIND_TOKEN is authoritative.

CRLF.description: Carriage return + line feed. The only canonical value.

LF.description: Line feed only. Non-canonical; importers in the strict class reject it.

URI_REFERENCE.description: A portrait row referencing content by locator rather than embedding it. The canonical form, because an embedded image dominates the octet budget.

INLINE_ENCODED.description: A portrait row embedding transport-encoded image bytes inline.

VCFProperty.description: One emitted card property, as the publisher parsed its own output.

NAME.description: Property name verbatim and upper-case, e.g. `EMAIL`.

PARAMETERS.description:
Parameter tokens verbatim in emission order, each a single `name=value`
pair. A parameter the emitter wrote without a value is carried verbatim.

VALUE.description:
Property value with the text format's escaping REMOVED, so a consumer
reads a value rather than re-implementing an unescaper. `CARD` retains the
escaped form.

GROUP.description: Grouping prefix the property was emitted under, when the emitter used one.

ORDER.description:
Zero-based position of this property in the canonical emission order for
this FORM. Two conforming emitters agree on this number.

OCTET_LENGTH.description:
Octet length of the property's complete UNFOLDED content line, excluding
the line terminator. This is the number folding is applied against.

VCFAlias.description: One identity address row: the machine-readable half of the card.

SIGNING_KEY.description: The literal public key that produced the profile's signature.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: The literal public key a correspondent encrypts to.

PROFILE_SIGNATURE.description: The profile's own signature value, so a scanner can verify without a second fetch.

PROFILE_SIGNATURE_TIMESTAMP.description: The profile's signature timestamp, as the publisher stated it.

PROFILE_CONTENT_ID.description: Content identifier of the exact profile bytes the card projects.

LEDGER_ACCOUNT.description: A distributed-ledger account the profile proves control of. CHAIN names which ledger.

OTHER.description: A row whose kind this standard does not model. KIND_TOKEN is authoritative.

KIND_TOKEN.description:
The row's kind label verbatim as emitted — the leftmost domain label.
Authoritative when KIND is OTHER.

LOCAL_PART.description: Everything left of the separator in the emitted address, verbatim.

DOMAIN.description:
Everything right of the separator in the emitted address, verbatim. This
is publisher data: the identity domain of the deployment that produced the
card, never a value this standard fixes.

ADDRESS.description:
The complete emitted address, `LOCAL_PART` then the separator then
`DOMAIN`, verbatim. Carried whole because it is what the importer stores
and what a consumer matches on.

ENCODING.description:
Transport encoding of LOCAL_PART verbatim and lowercase. An address
local part has a hard octet cap, so raw hexadecimal key material does not
fit and a compact binary-to-text encoding is REQUIRED for key rows.

ALGORITHM.description:
Cryptographic algorithm the row's key or signature belongs to, verbatim as
the profile states it. A key without a named algorithm is not verifiable.

PUBLIC_KEY.description:
The profile's published public key value verbatim, for key rows. The SAME
bytes LOCAL_PART transport-encodes, carried in the profile's own spelling
so a consumer can join card to profile without decoding. NEVER an extended
public key and NEVER a derivation path.

CHAIN.description: Ledger token verbatim for LEDGER_ACCOUNT rows.

ON_COMPACT_CARD.description: Whether this row survives into the COMPACT form.

OCTET_LENGTH.description: Octet length of the complete UNFOLDED row as emitted.

VCFSubject.description: The profile this card projects, and the provenance that binds them.

PEER_ID.description: Network peer identifier the profile is anchored to, verbatim.

DN.description: The profile's distinguished name verbatim, as published.

PROFILE_CID.description:
Content identifier of the exact, size-prefixed profile bytes projected.
With PROFILE_SHA256 this is what makes a card re-derivable.

PROFILE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of those same profile bytes as 64 lowercase hexadecimal
characters.

PROFILE_SIGNATURE_TIMESTAMP.description:
The profile's signature timestamp as the publisher stated it, in
milliseconds since the Unix epoch. 0 means unpublished.

SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY.description:
Literal public key that produced PROFILE_SIGNATURE, verbatim from the
profile. Never an extended public key, never a derivation path.

ENCRYPTION_PUBLIC_KEY.description:
Literal public key a correspondent encrypts to, verbatim from the profile.
Never an extended public key, never a derivation path.

SOURCE_STANDARD.description:
Four-character standard code of the projected profile record, `$`
included. Carried so the projection is not silently assumed.

VCFConformance.description:
Everything needed to decide whether this card is servable, and whether two
implementations produced the same bytes.

VERSION.description: Card format version token verbatim as emitted, e.g. `3.0`.

PROFILE.description:
Identifier of the emission profile the card conforms to, verbatim, naming
the annex revision the publisher implemented.

LINE_ENDING.description: Line terminator the card text uses.

CRLF.description: Carriage return + line feed. The only canonical value.

LF.description: Line feed only. Non-canonical; importers in the strict class reject it.

FOLD_OCTET_WIDTH.description:
Octet width beyond which a content line is folded onto continuation lines.
0 means the publisher folded nothing, which is non-canonical.

BYTE_LENGTH.description:
Octet length of `CARD` exactly as emitted, folding and terminators
included. This is the number a serving surface budgets against.

UNFOLDED_BYTE_LENGTH.description:
Octet length the same card would have with folding removed. Carried so a
folding disagreement is detectable without unfolding the text.

BYTE_BUDGET.description:
Octet ceiling of the surface this card was produced for. 0 means the
publisher states no ceiling; it never means a ceiling of zero.

WITHIN_BYTE_BUDGET.description:
Whether BYTE_LENGTH is within BYTE_BUDGET. False with a non-zero budget
means the card is a valid record that is NOT servable on that surface.

CARD_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of `CARD` as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. This is the
value two implementations compare to prove byte-identical projection.

PROPERTY_COUNT.description:
Number of property rows emitted, unfolded. Carried so a truncated card is
detectable before parsing.

CARRIES_VERIFICATION_CHAIN.description:
Whether the card carries a complete verification chain: a signing-key row,
an encryption-key row, and a profile-signature row, all present in the
UNFOLDED text. A card without all three cannot verify its own subject and
is not servable as an identity card.

CARD_ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier of this card. Together with the publishing key
it is the card's identity across every republication.

FORM.description: Which canonical emission form this record carries.

FULL.description: The complete downloadable card: contact rows, the full verification chain, and the photo when one is published.

COMPACT.description: The density-limited card meant for optical scanning: contact rows plus the minimum verification chain, and nothing whose absence is recoverable from the profile the signature binds.

CARD.description:
The emitted card text VERBATIM: every octet an importer will read,
including folding and line terminators. Authoritative over PROPERTIES and
ALIASES in every disagreement.

MEDIA_TYPE.description:
Media type the card is served as, verbatim, including its charset
parameter.

SUBJECT.description: The profile this card projects and the provenance binding them.

PROPERTIES.description: The publisher's parse of `CARD`, in canonical emission order.

ALIASES.description: The identity address rows carried by `CARD`, in canonical emission order.

PHOTO_POLICY.description: How the card carries a portrait, if at all.

URI_REFERENCE.description: A portrait row referencing content by locator rather than embedding it. The canonical form, because an embedded image dominates the octet budget.

INLINE_ENCODED.description: A portrait row embedding transport-encoded image bytes inline.

PHOTO_URI.description:
Locator of the portrait content under URI_REFERENCE, verbatim as emitted.
Empty under every other policy.

PHOTO_MEDIA_TYPE.description: Media type of the portrait content verbatim, when one is carried.

CONFORMANCE.description: Emission facts and the digest two implementations compare.

PRODUCER_ID.description:
Reverse-DNS identifier of the component that produced the card, so two
projectors are distinguishable when their bytes differ.

PRODUCER_VERSION.description: Build or release identifier of that component verbatim.

GENERATED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp at which the card was projected.

EXPIRES_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp after which a consumer re-projects
from the profile rather than serving this card. Empty means no expiry.

TAGS.description: `namespace:value` facets, sorted and deduplicated. See TAG GRAMMAR above.

NOTES.description: Publisher note about this card; never a substitute for a field.
